boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named California-campus destinations for reading, meals, classes, worship, performances, and recreation.

cards.title: Read together in the St. Bernardine Library
cards.subtitle: California campus • study space
cards.notes: Bring the next Great Books reading, then use the library’s group-study rooms when your discussion needs a place beyond the quiet main areas.
cards.short_summary: A 65,000-book library with dedicated group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the library holds approximately 65,000 books and recordings and has three study rooms that may be used for group study.
cards.source_title: St. Bernardine of Siena Library | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Students and faculty may check out books; visiting scholars need the Dean’s permission to use the library.

cards.title: Meet over a meal at St. Joseph Commons
cards.subtitle: California campus • dining commons
cards.notes: Use a scheduled meal as an easy meeting point before heading to class, the library, or an evening campus program.
cards.short_summary: The campus dining location used for orientation meals and student gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s 2026 California orientation schedule lists breakfast, lunch, and dinner in St. Joseph Commons.
cards.source_title: California 2026 Orientation Schedule | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Dining availability and access depend on the College’s current schedule and campus policies.

cards.title: Check the St. Cecilia Hall event calendar
cards.subtitle: California campus • auditorium and coffee shop
cards.notes: Look for a lecture, concert, or student production, and plan to arrive with enough time to find the auditorium entrance.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed lecture and concert hall with an auditorium and coffee shop.
cards.evidence_claim: The College campus map identifies St. Cecilia Lecture & Concert Hall as an auditorium and coffee-shop location; a 2025 College report places a student production there.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Events and coffee-shop service vary; confirm current campus announcements before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady of the Most Holy Trinity Chapel
cards.title: Pause at Our Lady of the Most Holy Trinity Chapel
cards.subtitle: California campus • chapel
cards.notes: Check the College’s current Catholic-life schedule, then visit respectfully for a service or a quiet moment of prayer.
cards.short_summary: The campus chapel, used for Mass and prayer during finals week.
cards.evidence_claim: The College reported that California-campus students gathered in the chapel each morning during finals week for prayer.
cards.source_title: Blessings for Finals Week, Fall 2022 | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Services and visitor access are subject to the College’s current religious-life schedule and policies.

cards.entity_name: Pope St. John Paul II Athletic Center
cards.title: Plan a recreation session at the JPII Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: California campus • athletics
cards.notes: Coordinate with fellow students for a game or workout, and use the facility in line with current athletics and campus rules.
cards.short_summary: A 2022 athletic center with courts, weights, climbing walls, and a pool.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the California athletic center has hardwood basketball courts, weight rooms, climbing and bouldering walls, and an outdoor swimming pool.
cards.access_notes: Facility use is for students under current College athletics policies; verify access before planning a session.

cards.title: Find your science-session meeting point
cards.subtitle: California campus • science hall
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate Albertus Magnus Science Hall before a scheduled class, lab, or academic appointment.
cards.short_summary: The map-listed science building on the California campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map lists Albertus Magnus Science Hall among its campus buildings.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Academic building access follows current College schedules and policies.

cards.title: Use St. Augustine Hall as a class landmark
cards.subtitle: California campus • classrooms
cards.notes: Check your section assignment and arrive early enough to find the right classroom and reconnect with classmates before discussion.
cards.short_summary: A named classroom building on the California campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map identifies St. Augustine Hall as a classroom building.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Classrooms are for scheduled academic use; access is governed by College policy.

cards.title: Walk the campus Stations of the Cross
cards.subtitle: California campus • devotional destination
cards.notes: Use the marked Stations of the Cross for a self-guided devotional walk, taking care to stay on established campus paths.
cards.short_summary: A named devotional destination on the College’s California campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map lists Stations of the Cross as destination 16.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Follow current campus access rules and use established paths.

cards.title: Take a campus-map walk to Hacienda Ponds
cards.subtitle: California campus • recreation landmark
cards.notes: Use the marked ponds as a waypoint on a daytime campus walk, and follow posted guidance around the water and surrounding grounds.
cards.short_summary: The map identifies Hacienda ponds as a recreation feature near the Hacienda.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map lists both the Hacienda and the Hacienda ponds.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Use only according to current College rules; water activities are not assumed or implied.

cards.title: Use Founders Plaza as an outdoor rendezvous
cards.subtitle: California campus • plaza
cards.notes: Set it as a clear daylight meeting point before walking to nearby buildings, and leave space for any scheduled campus activity.
cards.short_summary: A named plaza shown on the College’s California campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s California campus map labels Founders Plaza as recreation feature d.
cards.source_title: California Campus Map | Thomas Aquinas College
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use is subject to current campus access rules and scheduled events.
